kitDescription: Jackal is an Iron rocket-launcher Defender whose kit is almost entirely defensive. When she is attacked 10 times, she debuffs the highest-HP enemy with increased Damage Taken and reduced ATK for 10 seconds. At the start of battle she links herself and the two highest-ATK allies to equally share incoming damage and grants them a 120-second DEF buff. Her Burst I gives all allies a 10-second DEF buff and, for 15 seconds, boosts the Burst Skill damage of allies whose burst skills target a single enemy. In a damage sim where the boss never attacks, her only offensively relevant contributions are the boss Damage-Taken debuff and the single-target burst-damage amp.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: every kit line is either FAITHFUL with discriminating counterfactual pins (the two defPct grants — magnitude, scope, trigger timing, duration, and byte-identical inertia all pinned GREEN vs shipped and RED vs named nearest-wrong models) or a DOCUMENTED_GAP carrying an estimate, recipe, tier, and binding precedent (maiden for the attacked-10x cluster, trina for the description-scoped burst amp). Convergence is strong where it matters: S5's adapted run is fully GREEN and its two unmodified reds are blind-side fixture arithmetic (5-unit assumption vs the 4-unit controlComp), a RECON_ERROR, not a divergence; S6 converged on the S2 DEF structure, the burst DEF encoding, and both burst/S2 unmodeled dispositions. The two S6 divergences resolve in the driver's favor: S6's hitCount:10 encoding of the S1 Damage-Taken line is exactly S2b's named nearest-wrong trigger misread ('attacked' = hits received, not own shots), self-flagged by S6 as an unmeasured guess, whereas the driver's omission matches the maiden precedent and is pinned deliberate by J1; and the driver's byFinalAtk:true follows the A3 literal-word rule that S2b derived independently (S6's omission is inert anyway). The honest cost is real and disclosed: jackal's two damage-relevant lines are absent, so her comps read cold by the ⚑1/⚑2 amounts — this is recorded, not silent. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the DOCUMENTED_GAP dispositions lean on precedent (maiden/trina GOs) rather than a fresh jackal-specific measurement, and the ⚑1 'near-permanent uptime' estimate is unanchored — if a boss-attack-cadence measurement ever lands, revisit whether an interval proxy for the S1 debuff beats the current zero.
